result.title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
result.summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TempoKV，一个免训练的预测式 KV cache 量化框架：观察到自回归视频生成中 key 可由时间历史高度预测、value 主要依赖当前 key 且只需短历史，于是按二者不同依赖分别预测并仅以低精度存储残差，预测器用少量 BF16 样本线性回归离线校准后固定，在多个视频扩散模型上取得更高压缩比与质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按状态依赖结构预测内部状态、只存残差」的缓存压缩视角，可能可供核查借鉴于 LVR 中 latent/注意力状态的压缩、缓存与信息保留问题，但原文面向视频生成，与多模态推理状态生成的联系仍需人工判断。
